description: Presentations on the Internet of Things at DEF CON 23 explores security vulnerabilities in connected consumer hardware, embedded Linux appliances, smart home protocols, and ZigBee wireless networks.

talks.title: Runa Sandvik, Michael Auger
talks.teaser: Runa Sandvik and Michael Auger demonstrate how they compromised a Linux-powered TrackingPoint smart rifle over Wi-Fi, altering target calculations.

talks.title: Qing Yang - Im A Newbie Yet I Can Hack ZigBee
talks.teaser: A beginner-accessible exploration of ZigBee radio communication, sniffing packet traffic, and exploiting vulnerabilities in smart lighting.

talks.title: IoT Village - Wesley Wineberg - Cameras Thermostats and Home Automation Controllers
talks.teaser: Wesley Wineberg analyzes attack surfaces across popular consumer IoT devices, detailing privilege escalation and remote exploit primitives.
